key_insight: BINEVAL turns LLM evaluation into a set of atomic binary questions, making judgments more interpretable, better calibrated, and useful for prompt improvement.
engineering_relevance: It offers a training-free way to debug, compare, and iteratively improve LLM outputs and evaluator prompts across open-ended generation tasks.
method: Use a meta-prompt to decompose a task into fine-grained binary evaluation questions.
Have an LLM answer each question independently for a given output.
Aggregate question-level verdicts into multi-dimensional scores and feedback for optimization.
evidence_signal: Across SummEval, Topical-Chat, and QAGS, BINEVAL matches or exceeds strong baselines like UniEval and G-Eval, with especially strong gains on factual consistency and better alignment to human score distributions.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of generated questions and may require careful prompt design to avoid biased or incomplete decomposition.
paper_title: Ask, Don't Judge: Binary Questions for Interpretable LLM Evaluation and Self-Improvement
